T: The Green Place grows peaches. The Wasteland grills.
D: Young Furiosa is taken from the Green Place and has to fight her way back across the Wasteland.
P: Serve the peaches when Furiosa plants the seed.
S: Green Place garden veg with whipped feta

Radishes, baby carrots, snow peas and cucumber from the garden around a whipped feta and herb dip, finished with olive oil and lemon zest. Blitz 200g feta with 100g Greek yoghurt, 2 tbsp olive oil, the zest and juice of half a lemon and a handful each of mint and dill until smooth and green flecked. Spread into a bowl and drizzle with oil. Trim 1 bunch radishes and 1 bunch baby carrots, string 150g snow peas and cut 1 cucumber into spears. Soak the vegetables in iced water 10 minutes, drain and arrange around the dip.
Bullet Farm chorizo with smoky honey

Thick coins of chorizo blistered in a smoking pan, glazed with honey, smoked paprika and sherry vinegar, served on picks with charred bread. Slice 4 chorizo sausages (about 500g) into 1.5cm coins. Heat a heavy pan over high heat and fry without oil for 4 minutes, turning, until blistered and the fat runs. Add 2 tbsp honey, 1 tsp smoked paprika and 1 tbsp sherry vinegar and toss for 1 minute until sticky. Grill 8 slices of sourdough until charred. Serve the chorizo on toothpicks with the bread to mop up the pan juices.

Yoghurt flatbreads slapped onto smoking hot steel until blistered and charred, brushed with garlic and parsley butter and sprinkled with salt. Mix 300g self-raising flour, 250g Greek yoghurt and half a tsp salt into a soft dough and knead 1 minute. Rest 10 minutes, divide into 8 and roll thin. Melt 60g butter with 2 crushed garlic cloves and 2 tbsp chopped parsley. Heat a heavy pan or barbecue plate until smoking and cook each bread 1 to 2 minutes a side until blistered. Brush with garlic butter straight away and sprinkle with flaky salt.
M: Lamb chops marinated in rosemary, garlic and lemon, grilled hot on the barbecue with charred corn.

Chicken thighs coated in a dark spice rub of smoked paprika, garlic, cumin and pepper, seared until blackened, with a sharp lime and chilli slaw. Mix 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp ground cumin, 1 tsp black pepper, 1 tsp brown sugar, half a tsp cayenne and 1 tsp salt. Rub over 8 chicken thigh fillets with a little oil. Sear in a very hot cast-iron pan or on the barbecue for 5 to 6 minutes a side until blackened and cooked through. Toss a quarter of a shredded cabbage, 1 grated carrot and coriander with the juice of 2 limes, 2 tbsp oil and a sliced chilli.
W: Charred peach halves, thyme honey and vanilla ice cream
Peaches halved and grilled cut side down until caramelised, drizzled with honey and thyme and served with vanilla ice cream.
K: Cold milk blended with vanilla ice cream, malted milk powder and honey until thick, poured into tall glasses with a drizzle of honey. Chill 4 tall glasses. Blend 500g vanilla ice cream, 400ml cold milk, 4 tbsp malted milk powder and 2 tbsp honey until thick and smooth. Drizzle a little honey down the inside of each glass, pour in the shake and sprinkle with 1 tbsp more malt powder. Serve straight away with straws.
